definitions.explanation: Describes pleasantly cool weather or temperature, especially refreshing coolness in summer or after hot weather.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{涼|すず}しいですね。
{秋|あき}は{涼|すず}しくなります。
{涼|すず}しい{風|かぜ}が{気持|きも}ちいい。

notes: 涼しい describes pleasant, refreshing coolness—the opposite of 暑い (atsui, hot). It has a positive connotation of comfort, unlike 寒い (samui, cold) which implies discomfort. Conjugation: 涼しくない (negative), 涼しかった (past).
